response.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_amount FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM per_account) SELECT p.account_id, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.mean_avg AS diff_above_mean FROM per_account p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.mean_avg ORDER BY diff_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The mean is the unweighted mean of the per-account averages (each account counts once), over all accounts having at least one PRIJEM or VYDAJ transaction.
VYBER and other or NULL types are excluded, as the request says to ignore any other or missing type.
Ties at the 10th place are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT.
